comparison.objective: Replace a toilet roll on a spring spindle while one spindle end is already held in a socket.
comparison.physical_skill: Compress and steer a spring-loaded spindle, align its free end with the opposite socket, and release it into retention while supporting the roll.
comparison.success_condition: Both spindle ends are seated, the roll is retained and usable after release, and the assembly is not dropped or incorrectly supported.
comparison.reason: Spring-spindle seating is an insertion-and-release task, not iterative adjustment of damping followed by setscrew locking and dynamic stop validation. Any missing force thresholds in the spindle record do not make these objectives plausible duplicates; the candidate also lacks numeric rebound, overload, and drift limits.
